name: track hvac maintenance agreements and remind customers when service is due with AI

parameters.content:
## track hvac maintenance agreements and remind customers when service is due with AI

### How it works

1. When a new maintenance agreement is signed, the office posts it to the webhook. The workflow checks the entry, rejects anything missing key details, and adds the agreement to the tracker.

2. An AI assistant writes a welcome email to the new customer, confirming the plan, the next service date and what to expect. The welcome goes out and the agreement is logged with status active.

3. Every day at 07:00 the workflow reads the tracker and finds agreements whose next service is due within 3 days or already overdue. Customers get a friendly reminder email. Overdue customers are then listed in one short email to the office so the dispatcher can book the visit.

4. Every Monday an AI review of the agreement book is emailed to the office: how many are active, which services are due this week, which agreements are overdue, and which are close to renewal.

### Setup steps

- Create a Google Sheet with an Agreements tab and the columns used in the workflow nodes (agreement_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone, address, system_type, filter_size, service_frequency_months, last_service_date, next_due_date, agreement_end_date, status, office_email, welcomed_at, last_reminded_at, reminder_count), then paste the spreadsheet id into the Google Sheets nodes and keep the tab name Agreements.

- Add a Google Sheets credential and a Gmail account used for the automated reminder emails.

- Add an OpenAI compatible chat model credential (gpt-4o-mini or similar) for the welcome and reminder drafts.

- Set the office email in the webhook payload, or default it in the Normalize node, so alerts and the weekly review reach the right person.

- Point the webhook URL at your CRM, form tool or process.

### Customization

- Change the service window (currently next service due within 3 days or overdue) in the Flag Due Agreements code node.

- Adjust the daily and weekly schedules to your office hours.

- Swap the intake webhook for a Google Sheets trigger if you want to keep the tracker as the source of truth.

## 1. Agreement intake and welcome

A webhook collects a new maintenance agreement. Missing details are rejected by email.

## 2. Daily service reminders

Every morning, agreements due for service are emailed a reminder. Overdue customers are then listed for the office.

## 3. Weekly agreement review

Each Monday, an AI review of active agreements and renewals is emailed to the office.

options.systemMessage: You are the office assistant at an HVAC company that sells maintenance agreements. Write a short friendly welcome email to a new maintenance customer. Use ONLY the supplied details. Confirm the plan, mention the next service date and the filter size or system, say the team will handle the visit and remind them they can reschedule by replying, and close warmly. Keep it under 130 words, plain paragraphs, no markdown, no em dashes. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys: subject (max 10 words) and body (the full email).

Tell them their filter or system service is due (or overdue if days until due is negative), how soon, and that they can reply to this email to schedule a convenient time. If the service is overdue, add one gentle line that we are happy to get it scheduled right away. Keep it under 120 words, plain paragraphs, no markdown, no em dashes. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys: subject (max 10 words) and body (the full email).

options.systemMessage: You are the office assistant at an HVAC company. Write the weekly maintenance agreement review email for the office manager. Use ONLY the supplied tracker data. If there are no active agreements, say the book is empty. Otherwise write 4 to 5 plain sentences: one headline on how many agreements are active, list how many services are due this week (name the customers), flag any overdue agreements by name, and mention how many renewals come up in the next 60 days with one practical suggestion. No markdown, no bullets, no em dashes, under 150 words. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys: subject (max 10 words) and body (the full email).
